purpose: Determine why the V42 body-preserving candidate cannot reach the frozen V41 object-amplitude target: distinguish an inaccurate object target from insufficient train-only residual-tail support and from a more fundamental transported-body/backbone incompatibility, without fitting or generating another field.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse the V42 decision-bound three-domain ensembles and their frozen 16 queries by 16 members exactly

object_target_audit.truth: held-out object log10 mean delta squared computed from the already frozen V42 truth cube
object_target_audit.prediction: the V41 object-amplitude prediction stored in the V42 uncalibrated ensemble, required to be identical across all 16 members of an object

tail_support_audit.residual: the exact centered unit-scale residual in the V42 tail-calibration-disabled arm
tail_support_audit.conditional_threshold_source: the frozen train-only V31 copula at the actual query backbone
tail_support_audit.zero_excess_endpoint: center min(residual, conditional_threshold) by one exact DC projection and evaluate object log10 mean delta squared
tail_support_audit.unit_excess_endpoint: the unchanged centered V42 uncalibrated residual
tail_support_audit.target_bracket: the frozen V41 prediction lies inclusively between the two endpoint log amplitudes
tail_support_audit.bracket_support_rule: at least 90 percent of all member-object pairs independently in every domain
extreme_location_support: recall of the 26 largest generated log-density voxels (native q99.99 count) by each conditional residual-tail mask
recall of the 3 largest generated log-density voxels (native q99.999 count) by each conditional residual-tail mask

fixed_branches.condition: object target passes all domains and q99.9 brackets at least 90 percent in every domain
object target passes all domains, q99.9 does not bracket, and q99 brackets at least 90 percent in every domain
object target passes all domains but q99 also fails to bracket at least 90 percent anywhere
object target fails its frozen held-out support rule anywhere
